# M3 Expressive Skill for Jetpack Compose

> An agent skill (SKILL.md format) for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Copilot that writes Material 3 Expressive Jetpack Compose code that compiles. Checked against androidx.compose.material3 1.5.0-beta02. MIT license.

Key facts:
- In material3 1.5.0-beta01/beta02 almost every Expressive API is stable. Still @OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3ExpressiveApi::class): LoadingIndicator, ContainedLoadingIndicator, LoadingIndicatorDefaults, MaterialShapes (+ RoundedPolygon.toShape/toPath, Morph.toPath), one checkable DropdownMenuItem overload, PullToRefreshDefaults.LoadingIndicator, one Slider thumb overload.
- In material3 1.4.0, MaterialExpressiveTheme, MotionScheme.expressive(), emphasized typography and the increased shape steps are internal; only ShortNavigationBar and WideNavigationRail are public.
- Deprecated in 1.5.0-beta02: ListItem(headlineContent = …), SearchBar(query, …), DockedSearchBar, TopSearchBar (renamed AppBarWithSearch), non-state Slider overloads.
- 28 Kotlin samples are compiled in CI (verify/ module in the repo).

Install:
- Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add sanikantv/m3-expressive-skill then /plugin install m3-expressive-compose@m3-expressive-skill
- Other agents: npx --yes skills add sanikantv/m3-expressive-skill --skill m3-expressive-compose -y
